notes:
Release notes for HC Studio version 2026.06.27.2:

- Server Infrastructure (Step 5) is now product-scope aware. It shows the server cards relevant to the products picked in Step 2 — including new DSPM Server and Classification Server (FDC) cards when DSPM or Classification is selected. Shared infrastructure (FSM, SQL) appears for every product that uses it.
- Any server type can still be added manually via 'Add Additional Server Instance'. Sessions saved before the DSPM/FDC server cards existed are backfilled automatically.

For more details, please refer to the official documentation or contact support.
